title: Pt(111) · VASP benchmark
description: Real VASP 6.4.2 calculation. Native augmented density; kT = 0.4 eV. A software integration fixture, not the 2016 DACAPO result.

title: Pt3Y(111) · paper reconstruction
description: PW91, four layers, 6×6×1 k mesh, kT=0.4 eV. Native VASP density with Pt-high/Y-low spatial contrast. The color range automatically fits the displayed surface.

title: Pt(111) · one Bader surface atom
description: The top atom's softness contribution, selected using AECCAR0+AECCAR2 Bader basins. Restore the full field or select another atom in the Bader tab.

title: Pt/Y-like slab · synthetic tutorial
description: Analytic illustration for learning the viewer. Not an electronic-structure calculation.
